provider: Hosting by Design — App hosting 24 TB (owners of seedbox.io)

egress.terms: Shared tiers metered (1TB->3TB, 2TB->6TB, 4TB->10TB, 8TB->25TB out). 18/24/28 TB dedicated tiers list "Unlimited" outgoing. "Unlimited incoming data" on all.

interface_detail: SSH included, app installer (Plex/Sonarr/rTorrent etc.), 10 Gbit+ uplink
chaining: Mount over SSHFS; 10 Gbit uplink is the best burst of the cheap set
limits_note: Metered egress below 18 TB; ~$2.42/TB only achievable at the 24 TB dedicated tier
reliability_note: seedbox.io now 301-redirects to hostingby.design — same operator (HNielsen Technologies ApS, DK). Brand consolidation means the old seedbox.io plans/prices are no longer separately purchasable.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
binding_note: no constraint in the record binds at this scale; the record carries no limit of a kind the vocabulary names
